correctness.rationale: Use arXiv:2306.03459v4, Theorems 5.2 and 5.3, to obtain Apéry and genus. The greedy digits have at most one lower value 2 and top digit<=1 since M<2(2^k-1), so T(j)<=k+1; N_{-M} gives c>=M^2+1. With e=k+1 and n>=3, m>=3 odd, obtain the polynomial margin and positivity from M>=3*2^n>4n+5>=2k+5+6/(k-1). An independent Dijkstra implementation compared 599039 exact Apéry entries in 119 allowed semigroups and verified g,F,Wilf bounds. This finite check is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The explicit strictly positive polynomial Wilf margin addresses a natural stated arithmetic inequality for the entire odd-parameter Proth family beyond the special 2^r+1 theorem. It supplies a quantitative all-parameter assertion without assuming exact Frobenius maximization, and is a motivated infinite-family extension of the 2023 Wilf result. It does not claim a general resolution of Wilf or a new genus formula; its simplicity and dependence on established Apéry data are acknowledged.
